# CC0 weather reference sounds

These recordings are generic development references used by Racing United's
module-owned weather audio definition. They are not tied to the renderer and do
not replace any user-authored rain textures or visual precipitation.

## Wind Whoosh Loop

- Source page: https://opengameart.org/content/wind-whoosh-loop
- Author: SketchMan3
- Licence: CC0 1.0 / public-domain dedication
- File: `wind_whoosh_loop.ogg`
- SHA-256: `0CFDBD3F21ED449689A9024264EDF267D0037A6495813A7010827672EC191DAC`

The native weather model crossfades adjacent rain recordings from the
authoritative physical rain rate and drives the wind recording from the same
wind-speed value shown by the Scene Weather GUI.
